user.title: Set up an Auto Thermostat
user.description: Choose what this thermostat controls and which sensors it should use.

data_description.name: Use a name that identifies the room.
data_description.heater: The switch or input boolean that turns your heater on and off. In cooling mode, choose the cooling switch instead.
data_description.temperature_sensors: Choose one or more temperature sensors. Available readings are averaged.
data_description.persons: Optional. Home is used if anyone is home. If you leave this empty, Home is always used.
data_description.ac_mode: Off for heating. Turn on only if the controlled switch runs a cooling device.

presets.title: Set up the temperature presets
presets.description: Choose the temperatures for Home, Away and Sleep, and how long Boost should run.

data_description.away_temp: Used when all tracked people are away.
data_description.sleep_temp: Used until you select Home or Away again.
data_description.boost_duration: How many minutes Boost should keep the controlled switch on, subject to the cycle limits.

control.title: Set up thermostat control
control.description: These settings work like Generic Thermostat. Cycle times and keep-alive are in seconds. Set a duration to 0 to disable it.

data_description.min_temp: Lowest target temperature allowed by the thermostat card.
data_description.max_temp: Highest target temperature allowed by the thermostat card.
data_description.target_temp: Used when you set a temperature manually and clear the presets.
data_description.initial_hvac_mode: Use Off to leave the switch off until you enable the thermostat.
data_description.cold_tolerance: Difference below the target required to start heating.
data_description.hot_tolerance: Difference above the target required to stop heating.
data_description.min_cycle_duration: How many seconds heating must stay on before a normal stop. Off mode and safety stops take priority.
data_description.max_cycle_duration: Optional safety cap for one uninterrupted run. Applies to Boost too.
data_description.cycle_cooldown: Minimum time in seconds to wait before restarting the switch.
data_description.keep_alive: Optional time in seconds between repeat commands to the switch.
data_description.target_temp_step: How much the target changes per card adjustment.

button.title: Choose a Boost button
button.description: Optional. Select a button event entity that reports short and long presses. Match its event_type values below. A short press starts or restarts Boost. A long press cancels it.

data_description.button_event: Choose an event.* entity. A plain button.* entity cannot report different press lengths.
data_description.short_press: Usually press_end, but the value depends on your button integration.
data_description.long_press: Usually long_press_end, but the value depends on your button integration.

error.invalid_temp_range: Maximum temperature must be greater than minimum temperature.
error.temp_out_of_range: The initial target and all preset temperatures must be within the configured limits.
error.invalid_cycle_range: Maximum on time must be greater than minimum on time.
error.same_button_events: Short and long press event types must be different.

init.title: Configure Auto Thermostat
init.description: Choose which settings you want to change.

devices.title: Edit thermostat devices
devices.description: Choose which switch, temperature sensors and people to use.

data_description.name: Name shown for this thermostat.
data_description.heater: Choose a switch or input boolean.
data_description.persons: Leave empty to stop automatic Home/Away switching.
data_description.ac_mode: Controls a cooling device instead of a heater.

presets.title: Edit temperature presets
presets.description: Change the preset temperatures or the Boost duration.

control.title: Edit thermostat control
control.description: Cycle times and keep-alive are in seconds. Zero disables a duration.

button.title: Edit Boost button
button.description: Choose an event.* entity and specify the event type for each press.

data_description.button_event: Clear this to stop listening to the button.
